readerCopy.body: One honest preference can loosen shame when the feared consequence turns out to be smaller than the rule built around avoiding it. When Chiron sextiles Lilith, sensitivity and autonomy cooperate, giving a small refusal or act of self-definition a chance to create a different ending. A changed term, declined request, or plainly stated preference can reveal how much authority an old judgment still has in practice. The useful change is not proving the past wrong in theory, but discovering what the present actually allows.
